name: Audio SFX
description: Import settings for sound effect audio files optimized for low-latency playback.
notes: manage_asset has NO set_import_settings action (earlier revisions of this file encoded one). The valid actions are import, create, modify, delete, duplicate, move, rename, search, get_info, create_folder and get_components, and `path` is required on every one of them. Apply audio import settings as manage_asset(action: "modify", path: "<asset path>", properties: { ... }). `config` and `settingsMap` are empty here by design -- the AudioImporter property names vary by platform override, so read the current shape with manage_asset(action: "get_info", path: ...) before writing rather than assuming a fixed key set. manage_asset is in the default-on `core` tool group, so no manage_tools activation step is needed.
